pages.text: If while hiking high in the mountains you come across a walking stone, do not think your eyes deceive you. Instead, draw your sword – for before you stands a rock troll.$(br2)True, not every encounter with these creatures ends in a fight - while not particularly intelligent, trolls are capable of reason.
Just like other monsters though, some are outright hostile and can't be reasoned with.

$(l)$(#fc5454)Behavior$()$(br)Rock trolls are vicious fighters, boasting both immense strength and defense, their stone-covered backs armors them too well for flanking tactics. Fleeing from a troll offers little safety, as they can throw stones with surprising speed and precision.$(br2)Their massive arms also allow them to block front attacks, making them as sturdy as a stone wall when blocking.

Thankfully, many rock trolls are not aggressive and can even $(l:tcots_witcher:misc/befriending_troll)befriend humans$(/l). However, a particular breed known as $(n)rabid trolls$() is purely hostile, easily recognized by their red eyes.
